title: Graph side words and the shrinking-neighborhood triangle
statement: For c,H,S and v as in [lem-pur-etale-graph-neighborhood-geometry], write graphFirstWord and graphSecondWord for the first and second proper/open/proper neighborhood words of the graph model [lem-sf-etale-locally-closed-graph-model]. The proper graph lifts are the literal pullback lifts; their properness follows from their proper projections. graphSide1, graphSide2 and graphMiddle are the specified graph-model factors. graphNeighborhoodTriangle is the inverse proper/open triangle for the smaller second graph and the induced open, followed by the open compositor. graphFirstShrinkIso is graphSide1_H inverse followed by graphSide1_S, between their canonically identified first words.

source.place: Tag 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition), independence-of-choices part of the proof and the final comparison of diagrams A-F. Elementary presentation move compared with upstream LowerShriekComposition.lean, rightDerivedLowerStarCompOpenImmersionLowerShriekIso and the eh factor in nonempty_iso_rightDerivedLowerShriek_comp. This is a new obligation, not a theorem claimed to be proved by that Lean existence declaration.

proof.text: Each graph followed by its separated neighborhood projection is respectively the identity or a, so proper-to-separated proves properness. Both coordinates show that the first graph lift is unchanged. The side and middle words are the explicit graph-model isomorphisms. The shrinking triangle is the inverse proper/open triangle for the graph identity proved in the geometry node, under the ambient proper direct image, with the open-composition isomorphism.
